description: Stepped-on (blocked) calls detected by the cockpits for one callsign in the last 30 minutes, newest first.

configuration.query: FROM unstep-events | WHERE type == "AnomalyEvent" AND callsign == ?callsign AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 30 minutes | SORT @timestamp DESC | KEEP @timestamp, event_id, callsign, frequency | LIMIT 20
